# https://protels.com

## About
Protels Hotels & Resorts operates four all-inclusive resorts in Egypt and Zanzibar.

## Properties
- Protels Crystal Beach Resort — Marsa Alam, Red Sea, Egypt
- Protels Beach Club & Spa — Marsa Alam, Red Sea, Egypt
- Protels Royal Bay Resort & Spa — Hurghada, Red Sea, Egypt
- Protels La Plage — Zanzibar, Tanzania

## Services
All-inclusive meal plans, PADI-certified diving, water sports, spa treatments, kids clubs, aqua parks, multiple restaurants, entertainment programs.
